fiveTestsCompliance.test01Exit: Zero-cost SQLite/JSON-LD bulk export for any LGA switching TSPs; <60s ClearAm consent revocation; mandatory *347*LGA# USSD & paper-assisted counter fallback.
fiveTestsCompliance.test02Code: CC0-1.0 Public Domain specifications + Apache-2.0/MIT @nigeriastack/lga-kiosk-kit reference SDK.
fiveTestsCompliance.test03Audit: Daily signed SHA-256 Merkle roots (/v1/audit/treasury-merkle-root & /v1/audit/merkle-root) proving zero SJLGA or platform escrow.
fiveTestsCompliance.test04Govern: Tripartite WG-05 & WG-03 governance with ALGON, State Auditors General, NFIU, and civic monitors.

modules.fourthScheduleMandate: Fourth Schedule Para 1(b), (e), (h): Public roads, drains, refuse disposal, and primary facility upkeep.
modules.painPointSolved: Citizens lack an offline channel to report burst pipes, blocked drainages, or clinic closures; Chairmen cannot verify if contractors fixed the fault.

modules.fourthScheduleMandate: Fourth Schedule Para 1(f) & 2(d): Local building setback, culvert, and commercial stall erection approval.
modules.painPointSolved: Eliminates extortion by unverified field inspectors and coordinates local setback permits with State GIS parcels.

modules.fourthScheduleMandate: Fourth Schedule Para 1(h): Public conveniences, sewage, faecal sludge management (FSM), and rural borehole O&M.
modules.painPointSolved: Prevents rural borehole breakdown from uncollected O&M tariffs and stops illegal sewage dumping by un-tracked desludging trucks.

modules.fourthScheduleMandate: Fourth Schedule Para 1(e), (i), (k): Licensing of markets, lock-up shops, kiosks, bakeries, eateries, liquor & outdoor signage.
modules.painPointSolved: Eliminates forged paper demand notices and multiple taxation by touts; provides verifiable shop credentials for MSME micro-credit.

modules.fourthScheduleMandate: Fourth Schedule Para 1(i): Registration of all births, deaths, burials, and customary/local government marriages; NPC Act.
modules.painPointSolved: Prevents unregistered rural births/deaths during network drops and stops forged marriage/death certificates in probate and visa filings.

modules.fourthScheduleMandate: Nigerian Constitutional Federal Character & LGA Origin/Residency Attestation Mandate.
modules.painPointSolved: Eliminates forged paper LGA Indigene letters, multi-week ward endorsement delays, and travel burdens via a 72-hour SLA and USSD community vouching.

modules.fourthScheduleMandate: Fourth Schedule Para 1(e) & (h): Slaughter slabs, abattoir hygiene, and market fire-safety clearances.
modules.painPointSolved: Replaces fake paper environmental and fire clearance letters with geo-stamped inspection photos and time-bounded Section 84 QR certificates.

modules.fourthScheduleMandate: Fourth Schedule Para 1(f): Construction and maintenance of feeder roads, drains, street lighting, and ward micro-projects.
modules.painPointSolved: Blocks ghost ward projects and payments for unexecuted feeder-road grading by requiring geo-fenced before/after SureEvidence photo hashes before milestone release.

modules.fourthScheduleMandate: Fourth Schedule Para 1(j) & Land Use Act 1978 s. 6: Assessment of privately owned houses/tenements and Customary Rights of Occupancy.
modules.painPointSolved: Eliminates arbitrary manual assessments, cash diversion, and double-allocation of Customary C of O parcels during active Customary Court disputes.

modules.fourthScheduleMandate: Fourth Schedule Para 1(e) & SC/CV/343/2024: Collection of daily fees in markets, motor parks, loading bays, and inter-LGA haulage corridors.
modules.painPointSolved: Eradicates cash touting (agbero leakage), fake paper tickets, and inter-LGA commercial vehicle double-taxation via offline POS/USSD tickets and a verifiable Inter-LGA Corridor Pass.

modules.fourthScheduleMandate: Fourth Schedule Para 2(c): Provision and maintenance of Primary Health Care (PHC), immunization, and Seasonal Malaria Chemoprevention (SMC).
modules.painPointSolved: Replaces lost paper tally sheets and prevents vaccine/malaria commodity stockouts in rural wards (scaling the verified Kebbi State 21-LGA baseline nationwide).

modules.fourthScheduleMandate: Section 7(1), Section 162 CFRN & Supreme Court SC/CV/343/2024 Direct FAAC + IGR Fiscal Accountability.
modules.painPointSolved: Provides real-time ward-level transparency over direct FAAC allocations and SplitDirect local IGR collections with daily signed SHA-256 Merkle roots.

modules.fourthScheduleMandate: Customary, Area, and District Courts operating at the LGA level across the 36 States + FCT; NDPA 2023 ss. 30–31.
modules.painPointSolved: Digitizes paper-bound Area/Customary courts offline, preserves appellate records to State High Courts, and locks matrimonial/minor files inside INTERNAL_RESTRICTED_NDPA.

modules.fourthScheduleMandate: Fourth Schedule Para 1(g): Naming of roads and streets and the numbering of houses.
modules.painPointSolved: Assigns every rural and peri-urban house/shop an offline-computable 3x3m alphanumeric StreetGrid address linked to official LGA street-naming gazettes.
